baseCohortDefinition.name: Lost to followup patients (excluding dead and transferred out)

config.sql: SELECT DISTINCT e.patient_id FROM encounter e WHERE e.encounter_type IN (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid IN ('8d5b27bc-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f', '8d5b2be0-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f')) AND e.encounter_datetime < DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND e.voided = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM encounter e2 WHERE e2.patient_id = e.patient_id AND e2.encounter_type IN (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid IN ('8d5b27bc-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f', '8d5b2be0-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f')) AND e2.encounter_datetime > e.encounter_datetime AND e2.encounter_datetime <= :endDate AND e2.voided = 0) AND e.patient_id NOT IN (SELECT patient_id FROM person p WHERE p.voided = 0 AND p.death_date IS NOT NULL AND p.death_date <= :endDate) AND e.patient_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT e3.patient_id FROM obs o INNER JOIN encounter e3 ON o.encounter_id = e3.encounter_id WHERE o.concept_id = (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '159938AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA') AND o.value_coded IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid IN ('159949AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA', 'a89b2410-1350-11df-a1f1-0024e8c6b857', 'a89a8f20-1350-11df-a1f1-0024e8c6b857')) AND e3.encounter_datetime <= :endDate AND e3.voided = 0 AND o.voided = 0)
